title: Process Tabs
description: Save and switch between named sets of editor tabs without reorganizing your workspace or keeping a sidebar open.

title: Prism CSV — Table Editor & Viewer
description: Open CSV/TSV files as a fast, colorful table: edit cells, drag & drop columns, filter, multi-sort, value lists and column statistics.

title: Nifty Python REPL: Send Code to Python & IPython
description: Send lines, blocks and # %% cells to a Python or IPython REPL that stays open, with multi-line code that just works, run-and-advance and cell lenses.

title: Nifty Paired Notebooks: Notebooks as .py Files
description: Keep Jupyter notebooks paired with plain Python (percent format) or Markdown files: readable git diffs, edit either side, outputs kept, and open any .py script as a notebook.

title: Nifty Notebook Servers: Kernels, Sessions & Files
description: Manage Jupyter servers from the side bar: see kernels and sessions, shut down, restart or interrupt kernels, and browse, open and edit the server's files directly.

title: FT Integration Standards
description: Lint live des templates Nunjucks (.njk) selon les conventions France Travail : indentation, camelCase des arguments de macros, collapse des littéraux à un élément, et règles projet personnalisées.

title: Nifty TOML: Format, Validate & Schemas
description: TOML support: highlighting, errors, a formatter that keeps comments, outline, folding, and JSON Schema validation, completion and hover (Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml via SchemaStore). TOML to JSON/YAML.

title: Nifty JSON Schema: Validate with Draft 2020-12 & 2019-09
description: Validate JSON, JSONC and YAML against JSON Schema 2020-12, 2019-09, draft-07, 06 and 04, with precise errors, hover, completion, SchemaStore lookup and schema generation.

title: Nifty Diagrams: PlantUML, Graphviz & D2 Preview
description: PlantUML, Graphviz (DOT) and D2 diagrams rendered on your machine: live preview beside the editor, SVG and PNG export, diagrams in the Markdown preview, errors in Problems. No server needed.

title: Borg JS
description: Autocomplete da Borg JS: escreve a chamada inteira de cada função, com seletor, arrow function e o import.

title: openEHR Arena Script Assistant
description: In-process MCP server exposing the DIPS Arena form-scripting agent guides as tools to GitHub Copilot Chat and other VS Code MCP clients. Complements the openEHR Assistant MCP server.

title: Serena Theme
description: Calm, harmonious color themes (Dark, Dark Vivid, Light, Light Vivid and High Contrast) with one meaning per color across all variants, plus Serena Icons, a matching file and folder icon theme in two editions.
